newsitem.title: ITALY: Pascale and Agnes to leave Stet - Treasury.
newsitem.headline: Pascale and Agnes to leave Stet - Treasury.

text.p: The managing director and chairman of Italian state holding Stet, Ernesto Pascale and Biagio Agnes respectively, will step down from the company, the Italian Treasury said in a statement on Friday.
Their places will be taken by Tommasi di Vignano, who is currently director-general of Telecom Italia, and Guido Rossi, a former head of the Italian bourse regulator Consob, the Treasury said.
"The Treasury, Industry and Telecommunications Ministries wish to express their deep appreciation for the work carried out by Agnes and Pascale," the Treasury statement said.
Earlier, the Treasury decided that Telecom Italia should be incorporated into Stet ahead of the privatisation of the telecoms sector later this year.
Agnes has headed Stet since 1991 while Pascale took over as managing director of the telecom holding in 1994.
